selected_evidence.requirement: Serve the inventory application over TCP/8181 while mandatory access control remains enforcing
selected_evidence.summary: Before and after reboot, node1 reports SELinux Enforcing, Apache confined under httpd_t, TCP/8181 labeled http_port_t and listening, content labeled httpd_sys_content_t, firewall access enabled, and an HTTP 200 response containing the inventory application.

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 mandatory restart and recovery sequence
selected_evidence.summary: Healthy baseline used boot ID 0581c914-b77e-45ce-b511-c0c9f578a303; the reboot timer acknowledged scheduling; node1 returned with changed boot ID 74673fd3-1b44-41ce-88bd-5e6077d1db29; Apache, SELinux enforcement and labeling, firewall state, listener, and inventory data fully recovered.
